assets.title: Week 8 sewing workspace bridge board
assets.description: A compact opener board with familiar sewing tools, fabric, and one or two visible action clues so students can bridge from Week 7 materials language into Week 8 process language.
assets.notes: Use as a fast review-preview board. Include a clean workspace with fabric, scissors, pins, measuring tape, and a sewing machine. Keep visible keys aligned to the opener questions and avoid clutter.

assets.title: Sewing actions vocabulary board
assets.description: One combined board showing clear keyed examples of common sewing actions and sewing-result nouns for the main Week 8 matching task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A cut, B fold, C pin, D sew, E press, F measure, G mark, H check, I seam, J stitch. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-J labels.

assets.title: Tools and actions board
assets.description: A clean board showing key sewing tools and objects used for controlled Use ___ to ___ phrase completion.
assets.notes: Show scissors, measuring tape, pins, sewing machine, and iron clearly. The board supports fill-blank tool phrases, so the visuals should anchor the tools without forcing a matching interaction.

assets.title: Simple hem reading sequence board
assets.description: A reading board with six clearly separated sewing-process images for the Week 8 hem-sample reading task.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A cut a small rectangle of fabric, B fold one edge, C pin the fold, D sew a straight line near the folded edge, E remove the pins, F press the hem and check the stitches. The reading text, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-F mapping.

assets.title: Reusable sewing-process gallery
assets.description: A reusable gallery with five clearly separated process images for listening, writing, and speaking.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A measure the fabric, image B mark the line, image C cut the fabric, image D fold the edge and pin it, image E sew near the edge and then press and check the result. The listening script, writing-card options, speaking prompts, and prompt notes must all use the same A-E mapping.

assets.title: Which step comes next listening audio
assets.description: A short Week 8 listening clip describing one simple sewing sequence with clear first, next, and final actions.
assets.notes: Transcript remains inside audio_prompts.json only. Do not create a separate transcript asset in the current phase.
